mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 9.5% signals severe labor market contraction, dampening consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 40% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth (GDPC1) above 0.5% quarterly and industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 0.3% monthly indicate robust economic expansion, driving corporate earnings and positive equity returns; the signal requires both series to show positive momentum.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 0.5% q/q and INDPRO growth > 0.3% m/m
failure_condition: The joint signal (GDPC1 growth > 0.5% q/q and INDPRO growth > 0.3% m/m) fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) during a post-recession housing market recovery signals increased construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST increases by > 5% in the prior month during a post-recession housing recovery.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, triggering expectations of monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer spending, a leading indicator of corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns consistently over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 50% of instances when RSAFS increases by > 1.0% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payrolls growth (PAYEMS) above 0.5% monthly and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at or below 0.2% indicate a strong labor market combined with accommodative monetary policy, fueling economic growth and positive equity returns.
regime_hint: labor market expansion with monetary ease
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% m/m and FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%) fails to produce positive 60d returns in > 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 90.0 (index) signals manufacturing contraction and supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 40% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0 over a 3-year rolling window.
